snippet.title: TRUCK DRIVER: The DUTCH CONNECTION - Story Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
#TruckDriver #TheDutchConnection #TruckSimulator
Experience the journey in Truck Driver: The Dutch Connection!
Dive into the gripping new chapter of the Truck Driver series as you meet unforgettable characters and follow an exciting Dutch storyline. This trailer showcases the dramatic narrative, unique personalities, and stunning locations that await every trucking fan.

Whislist now:
🔵PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015677
🟢Xbox Series X/S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/truck-driver-the-dutch-connection/9N29Q5L857JV

What You’ll See:
First look at the main characters and their backstories
Enhanced gameplay and scenic routes

Wishlist & Follow:
Get ready to haul, explore, and connect with the people who make the road their home. Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more updates on Truck Driver: The Dutch Connection!

#GamingTrailer #StoryTrailer

About SOEDESCO:
SOEDESCO is an independent video game developer, publisher, and distributor founded in 2002 by Soedesh Chauthi with its headquarters in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, and offices in Madrid, Spain & Pilsen, Czech Republic. We deliver creative content across multiple genres and platforms for a worldwide audience in physical and digital formats.
